name: modbros_rssreader
author: ModBros
description: Display the latest items from up to 3 RSS feeds

settings.name: feed_url_1
settings.label: RSS Feed URL 1
settings.description: The URL of the first RSS feed to display

settings.name: feed_name_1
settings.label: RSS Feed Name 1
settings.description: A display name for the first RSS feed (optional, defaults to 'Feed 1')

settings.name: feed_url_2
settings.label: RSS Feed URL 2
settings.description: The URL of the second RSS feed to display (optional)

settings.name: feed_name_2
settings.label: RSS Feed Name 2
settings.description: A display name for the second RSS feed (optional, defaults to 'Feed 2')

settings.name: feed_url_3
settings.label: RSS Feed URL 3
settings.description: The URL of the third RSS feed to display (optional)

settings.name: feed_name_3
settings.label: RSS Feed Name 3
settings.description: A display name for the third RSS feed (optional, defaults to 'Feed 3')

settings.name: item_count
settings.label: Number of items per feed
settings.description: The number of feed items to display per feed

settings.name: update_frequency
settings.label: Update frequency (minutes)
settings.description: How often to fetch the latest feed items (in minutes)
